author: @adrian.factomaton
scope: Offline consumer answer-kind and finite Moon/LEO/polarity design only. No consumer code, validator, frozen candidate/review, active catalog, curation, deployment or API behavior change.

candidate.answer: No. NASA states that the Great Wall isn't visible from the Moon.

exact_source_review.decision: accept attributed NASA Moon-only rebuttal; current source refresh not repeated

current_failure.mapping_risk: Removing the verdict guard alone would route every non-supported approved record into reviewed_abstention through existing binary fallback.
current_failure.classification: Compatibility/design gap, not evidence against the underlying factual claim.

publication_policy: Use an explicit exhaustive verdict-to-answer-kind mapping; unknown/missing verdict rejects rather than falling through to abstention. Recognized verdict is not itself approval.
Before approved selection all kinds have answer_kind withheld and answer null. Current C008 remains unavailable until implementation and every gate pass.

After exact non-author source acceptance, separately authorized curation and routing/implementation review, contradicted record keeps its original positive claim, negative attributed answer and contradicted evidence verdict; proposed answer_kind reviewed_contradiction, ordinary answer status only when consumer contract supports it.

A reviewed contradiction is a bounded evidence rebuttal, distinct from insufficient evidence. A reviewed abstention does not affirm or contradict its underlying raw claim. Never negate C008 into a supported successor merely to satisfy the current schema.

Any future implementation must coordinate Python projection/validation/export, TypeScript/backend/semantic/client response types and public schema/documentation. Enumerating these surfaces is not assigning edits or asserting compatibility.

Preserve historical author-awaiting-review metadata in frozen bytes. Detached exact review is current review state; label only exact bound creation-time review notes historical, retain NASA attribution, contextual unaided interpretation, one-family dependence and all substantive inquiry limits.

Query eligibility requires Moon plus naked-eye scope or explicitly resolved context. Missing vantage/instrument/referents clarify. Never infer LEO or all-space invisibility from C008; no automatic transfer of review/curation between C008 and C009.

Negated, tag and negative-interrogative questions require explicit proposition/polarity handling and declarative attributed response, no bare Yes/No inversion. Uncertain polarity clarifies; finite cases are not a general language classifier.

No new answer for unsupported instruments, distances, optical experiments, historical observations or compound scope. Preserve existing approved C009 policy and exact mappings; an example marked C009_policy_only is no new alias or factual verdict.

C009_boundary.policy: Existing separately approved low Earth orbit scope stays unchanged; C008 cannot supply it a contradiction or factual affirmation.

gates: Separate implementation scope with named new/changed files, ownership agreement for validator/review artifacts, appropriate migration/compatibility and failure tests, then exact implementation review
Detached exact source review attachment plus a separate curation decision by an actor distinct from the candidate author, bound to exact C008 version/review, with decision actor and recorder explicit
Routing review, active snapshot/growth and public runtime checks before inclusion; new objections may reopen
binding_rejections: unknown verdict silently converted to abstention
source distance/context treated as visibility proof
